_doc: Look settings of the kitchen: render, world light, prop light, post-processing. The room is in plan.json, the camera in trace.json.

environment._doc: Dusk through the open top of the cutaway room and one small window: little sky light, the hearth and the oven do the lighting. No haze, no rain.

post._doc: kuwahara: painterly brush size in px. bloom: glare strength above threshold. grade: lift/gamma/gain RGB. vignette: edge darkening 0..1.

rain._doc: No rain falls in the cookhouse (count 0). `sheltered` is the box under the roof: the shared weathering of wood and iron reads it and keeps them dry.
